code_origin: New EasyViz implementation from the data-only create brief. Metadata from the earlier example identifies GII units and inherited source licenses.

article.title: Mining Biosynthetic Gene Clusters in Carnobacterium maltaromaticum by Interference Competition Network and Genome Analysis

data_license: CC BY-NC 4.0, inherited from the supplied repository README as recorded in the established microbiology example.
article_license_context: CC BY 4.0 per inherited article provenance; no article figure is copied here.
upstream_conversion: Existing normalization omitted the interspecific EGDe column and normalized delimiter/decimal formatting. This create example copies the complete resulting 76 x 76 matrix unchanged.
selection: 20 rounded, evenly spaced ranks from all 76 rows and independently from all 76 columns, each ordered by descending full-matrix arithmetic mean then strain ID.
calculations: Arithmetic means over all 76 partners; no clipping of negative GII, no imputation, no inferential statistics, no bioinformatics software.
claims: Descriptive visualization and design showcase only; selected ranks are not a random or prevalence-representative sample.

palette_refresh.basis: Observed PDF vector fills; categorical selections and explicitly interpolated sequential ramps.
palette_refresh.caption_policy: Narrative text removed from panel and provided separately in caption.md.

prior_style_refinement.basis: Actual PDF inspection of PROGENy Fig. 2b/c, scWAT Fig. 2b and Vanneste Fig. 4d; adopted strong signed contrast around a light neutral center, thin purposeful axes and compact metadata. Colors chosen by EasyViz, not sampled.
prior_style_refinement.normalization: TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-400, vcenter=0, vmax=1000), explicitly piecewise linear. x <= 0: u=(x+400)/800; x >= 0: u=0.5+x/2000. Inverse: u<=0.5 -> x=-400+800u; u>=0.5 -> x=2000*(u-0.5). This replaces earlier globally linear Normalize; limits and values remain unchanged.
prior_style_refinement.strokes: 0.45 pt charcoal axes; no mean grids or matrix seams; borderless sky-blue means; charcoal analyzed tiles; outlined white not-analyzed tiles and matching guide key.
prior_style_refinement.geometry_change: Only colorbar changed from [143,17,28,3] to [119,6,52,3] mm and its title moved to [145,11] mm for readable 0/250/500/1000 ticks. Matrix and aligned tracks unchanged.
prior_style_refinement.visual_review: Final third pass: implementer and independent EasyViz Figure Reviewer child inspected baseline, both candidates and synthetic. Final multi-hue preferred over first signed candidate and baseline, ready_with_notes. Independent recomputation and actual PNG colorbar scanlines confirm branch luminance order and color stops within one RGB level.
prior_style_refinement.luminance: Actual 1025-color sRGB relative-luminance sampling passes negative nondecreasing and positive nonincreasing arms. No asinh, power, quantile mapping, clipping, or binning.

style_refinement.basis: User request for a simpler bright single-hue map and interpretable numeric ranges; independent full-source and primary-method audit.
style_refinement.normalization: Normalize(-400,1000); u=(x+400)/1400, inverse x=-400+1400u. One slope throughout; zero at2/7, no special white center.
style_refinement.range_basis: Outward-rounded complete observed measurement range [-398.9071599,981.4179003] minutes.
style_refinement.mean_range_basis: Both same-unit tracks; observed means span [26.63828563819737,664.245493066535]. Numeric range is shared; unequal physical axis lengths remain explicit.
style_refinement.measurement_definition_checked: Primary paper Section2.2 on printedPDFpage3: time-to-OD595=0.2 difference, GII=t2-t1; publication inhibition criterionGII>300min, without a new inference in this panel.
style_refinement.visual_review: Actual final PNG independently reviewed with caption/settings/QA, ready_with_notes; all 400 rendered cell colors, equal tick spacings, 8pt embedded Arial and physical dimensions verified. Limits: common-value contrast remains subtle; no special zero hue; unequal physical mean-axis lengths.
